setup.prerequisites.failed: A required local tool is still unavailable. I can try to repair this before setup continues.
setup.github.connect: GitHub access is required now. Connect/authorize GitHub for the repository you want to use, then tell me when it is complete.
setup.repository.ask: Which GitHub repository do you want ChatGPT and Codex to work on? Provide it as owner/repository.
setup.chat.ask: Please provide the ChatGPT reviewer conversation URL that should receive automation results.
setup.instructions.add: Your ChatGPT Project Instructions are ready. Add the generated instructions to your ChatGPT Project, then tell me when it is complete.
setup.sandbox.required: Before this installation can be marked ready, the isolated sandbox end-to-end test must pass.
doctor.healthy: Everything checked by Doctor is healthy.
doctor.attention: One or more checks need attention. I can guide you through the first problem.
repair.baseline: The repair framework is available. Runtime callback/runner repair is added in the next integration phase.
report.prepared: A sanitised diagnostic report was prepared locally. It has not been uploaded.
answer.github.invalid: GitHub authorization has not been confirmed yet.
answer.repository.invalid: The repository must look like owner/repository.
answer.chat.invalid: The reviewer Chat URL must be a ChatGPT conversation URL.
answer.instructions.invalid: Confirm after the generated Project Instructions have been added.
answer.sandbox.invalid: Sandbox verification must pass before setup can finish.
answer.action.unknown: This installer action is not recognised.
answer.saved: Your answer was saved. Setup can continue.
report.consent.required: Nothing was uploaded. Explicit consent is required before a diagnostic report can be submitted.
report.file.missing: The prepared diagnostic report could not be found.
report.destination.missing: No feedback repository is configured for this development build.
report.submitted: The sanitised diagnostic report was submitted.
report.submit.failed: The diagnostic report could not be submitted. The local copy is still available.
setup.github_cli.connect: GitHub CLI needs to sign in on this computer. Complete only this sign-in step, then setup can continue.
setup.github_plugin.connect: Now connect/authorize the GitHub Plugin in ChatGPT for the repository you want to use. Complete only this step, then tell me.
github_cli.missing: GitHub CLI is not installed yet.
github_cli.login.failed: GitHub CLI sign-in did not complete successfully.
setup.control.failed: Automatic control-environment setup did not finish. I can inspect the error and retry without touching your project main branch.
setup.codex.ready: Codex now needs to be signed in and the isolated project folder needs to be trusted. Complete only this step, then tell me.
setup.codex.helper: Open Codex in the provided project folder, sign in with ChatGPT if prompted, and approve trust for that folder. Do not give Codex a coding task yet.
setup.browser.login: The dedicated reviewer browser now needs your ChatGPT sign-in. Sign in only in the separate browser window/profile, then tell me when it is complete.
answer.codex.invalid: Codex sign-in/trust has not been confirmed yet.
answer.browser.invalid: Reviewer browser sign-in has not been confirmed yet.
repair.not_ready: Repair cannot start yet because the isolated runtime has not been configured.
repair.failed: Automatic repair did not finish. I can use the diagnostic details to guide the next single step.
repair.success: Repair completed. The runner/browser were checked and pending callbacks were retried.
setup.codex.login: Codex needs to sign in with your ChatGPT account. Complete only this sign-in step.
setup.codex.trust_sandbox: Codex needs permission to work in the isolated sandbox folder. Open Codex there, approve trust for that folder, then tell me when it is done.
setup.codex.trust_project: The sandbox test passed. Now approve Codex trust for your real project folder. Do not give Codex a coding task; only approve the folder.
codex.login.failed: Codex sign-in did not complete successfully.
codex.folder.missing: The requested Codex folder is not available.
codex.trust.after_open: Codex was opened in the requested folder. After you approve folder trust and exit Codex, confirm this step.
setup.sandbox.waiting: The isolated sandbox test is running. You do not need to rerun Codex or change your real project.
setup.sandbox.chat_handles_review: When the automation callback appears in this reviewer Chat, the AI should review the sandbox result and trigger the independent Code Review for the exact commit. The user only needs to approve the final sandbox merge when asked.
setup.sandbox.merge_approval: The isolated sandbox change has passed implementation checks and independent Code Review. Please approve or decline merging this exact reviewed commit into the sandbox only. Your real project is not affected.
setup.sandbox.failed: The isolated sandbox implementation or validation failed. The real project was not modified.
setup.sandbox.start_failed: The isolated sandbox smoke test could not start or be inspected. The real project was not modified.
sandbox.review.created: Independent Code Review was requested for the exact sandbox commit.
sandbox.review.failed: The sandbox Code Review request could not be created.
sandbox.approval.required: Explicit approval is required before the reviewed sandbox commit can be merged.
sandbox.approval.created: The exact reviewed sandbox commit was approved for sandbox-only merge.
sandbox.approval.failed: The sandbox merge approval could not be created.
setup.target.activate_failed: The sandbox passed, but activation of your real project did not finish. The real project main branch was not changed; I can repair this activation step.
setup.generated_repo.connect: Two private repositories were created for this installation. Add both generated repositories to the ChatGPT GitHub connection, then verify that ChatGPT can access both before continuing.
answer.generated_repo.invalid: ChatGPT access to the generated control and sandbox repositories has not been verified yet.
setup.chat_registration.waiting: This Chat is being registered as an explicit callback destination. Wait for the CHAT-ROUTE-REGISTERED callback in this exact conversation, then resume setup.
setup.chat_registration.no_fallback: No other Chat will be used while registration is pending.
